text.en:
All orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof,
which are inconsistent with this Executive Order, are hereby amended, repealed
or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
, in the year of
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Six.
By authority of the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
